newsitem.title: USA: Saks making plans to bid for Barneys - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Saks making plans to bid for Barneys - NYT.

text.p: Saks Fifth Avenue of the holding company Saks Holdings Inc is making plans to try to buy bankrupt luxury retailer Barneys Inc, the New York Times reported on Wednesday.
The newspaper cited "people close to the situation" as saying Saks had signed a confidentiality agreement in order to review the retailer's financial records.

In order to sign the agreement, Saks first distanced itself from Isetan Co of Japan, an investor group with which it had agreed to make a joint bid for Barneys earlier in the year, it said. Saks decided to go for Barneys alone following the retailer's objection to its agreement with Isetan, it added.
Since it filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in January, Barneys has attracted a number of potential buyers.
Dickson Concepts of Hong Kong made a $350 million bid last month and has entered into informal talks with the retailer.

Neiman Marcus Group Inc has also expressed interest in a possible merger or acquisition, while France's LVMH Moet Hennessy-Louis Vuitton and Holt Renfrew of Canada have signed the same confidentiality agreement, it said.
The newspaper said Saks had yet to reach the stage of talks with the retailer.
